title: Constant acceptance probability amplification
statement: Let $\rho$ be a rational number, let $K$ be a natural number, and suppose $(1-\rho)^K\le 1/3$. For any language $L$ of bit strings, if an efficient verifier with a polynomial random-bit bound accepts every member with probability at least $\rho$ and rejects every nonmember for every choice of random bits, then $L$ has an efficient verifier with a polynomial random-bit bound that accepts every member with probability at least $2/3$ and rejects every nonmember for every choice of random bits.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ has an efficient verifier with polynomially many random bits, member acceptance probability at least $\rho$, and certain rejection on nonmembers
